question: What kind of sons are obtained by performing ten thousand repetitions?
premises: The practice involves ten thousand repetitions.
This practice results in obtaining sons.
Those sons are disease-free and long-living.
inference: Ten thousand repetitions grant sons who are free from disease and long-lived.
uncertainties: The object repeated ten thousand times is implied to be the mantra from the preceding verse.
plain_english: By ten thousand repetitions, one obtains sons who are free from disease and long-lived.
